rationale: C07 is a direct and material drafting template. Both proclamations belong to the same supplementation series and use nearly identical recitals and a two-part operative structure: accession by another government triggers application of previously withheld Schedule XX concessions, followed by corresponding amendment of the Cuba-specific list. The child adapts C07's machinery to Chile and March 16, 1949, while adding later protocol rectifications and amendments. C06 and C08 also materially anticipate portions of the child, especially its protocol/rectification machinery and accession-triggered tariff provisions, but C07 most closely matches the child's central two-part sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: said protocol for accession having been signed by the government of the Republic of Chile ... the government of the Republic of Chile will become a contracting party ... on March 16, 1949
shared_material.parent_excerpt: said protocol of provisional application has been signed ... with the result that said Governments will be contracting parties ...
shared_material.explanation: Both establish a government's impending status as a contracting party as the factual trigger for activating tariff concessions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Each of the concessions provided for in part I of said schedule XX ... shall ... no longer be identified in the 8th recital of said proclamations of December 16, 1947, and ... the rate of duty representing each such concession ... shall be applied
shared_material.parent_excerpt: each of the concessions provided for in part I of said schedule XX ... shall ... no longer be identified in the 8th recital of said proclamation of December 16, 1947, and ... the rate of duty representing each such concession ... shall be applied
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive, nearly verbatim operative language implementing the same tariff mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: PART II To the end that said exclusive trade agreement specified in the 3rd recital ... may be carried out, that the list set forth in the 9th recital of said proclamation of January 1, 1948, as amended and rectified, shall ... be further amended
shared_material.parent_excerpt: PART II To the end that said exclusive trade agreement specified in the 3rd recital ... may be carried out, that the list set forth in the 9th recital of said proclamation of January 1, 1948, as amended and rectified, shall be further amended
shared_material.explanation: The child reproduces C07's separate Cuba-agreement part and its exact list-amendment machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The application of the rates, rectifications, and amendments ... shall be subject to the applicable terms, conditions, and qualifications set forth in schedule XX and parts I, II, and III of said general agreement
shared_material.parent_excerpt: shall be applied, subject to the applicable terms, conditions, and qualifications set forth in said schedule XX, and parts I, II, and III, of said general agreement
shared_material.explanation: The child carries forward the same qualification clause while expanding it to cover the newly proclaimed rectifications and amendments.
